text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for service `ingress-gateway` — elevated 5xx rate (503/502) in us-west-2. Current alert: > 150 errors/min. Correlation id sample: `corr-7f2a1b`

sara: seeing user-facing errors on hosted API, customers reporting timeouts. Can oncall confirm severity?
mike: oncall here. CPU/gpu nodes look normal. Spike in gateway 5xx, tail latencies up. Routing retries incr.

andre: grabbing KV logs for corrids. sharing S3 link in a sec. probable upstream flapping to our auth service?
devon: adding customer impact: two large customers (acme, nova) with ~30 failed requests/min each. SDK retries happening.
elaine: noted that retry storm could amplify. Can we identify whether failures originate at ingress or upstream?
sara: initial traces show `egress-auth` returning 502 intermittently. gateway logs show repeated retries for same corrid.
mike: posting log bundle for quick grep: `s3://redwood-incident/3598887776/logbox.tar.gz`

andre: pasted few lines from gateway logs:```
[2025-09-14T09:12:23Z] corr-7f2a1b GET /v1/generate 502 upstream=egress-auth-1 instance=auth-01 latency=123ms retry=1
[2025-09-14T09:12:23Z] corr-7f2a1b GET /v1/generate 502 upstream=egress-auth-2 instance=auth-02 latency=98ms retry=2
[2025-09-14T09:12:24Z] corr-7f2a1b GET /v1/generate 503 upstream=egress-auth-3 instance=auth-03 latency=510ms retry=3
[2025-09-14T09:12:25Z] corr-8a3b2c POST /v1/embedding 200 upstream=embedding-01 instance=embed-02 latency=25ms
```\n\ndevon: hypothesis: auth cluster has a degradation affecting a subset of nodes causing elevated latencies and 502/503, gateway retries amplify error signals.
elaine: mitigation idea: reduce gateway retry attempts from 3->1 for the impacted route to reduce cascade. Can ops toggle?
mike: I can patch the route policy for `v1/generate` to set retries=1 and shorter timeout (5s) — rolling now, will push config and monitor.

incident-bot: Action taken: routing policy updated by mike at 09:15:10Z (retries=1, timeout=5s).

sara: after the change error rate dropped ~40% in 2 mins. still seeing some 503s from auth cluster but lower amplification.
andre: extracted correlation IDs for failed requests and uploaded trimmed KV logs to the dropbox: `s3://redwood-incident/3598887776/kvlogs/traces.jsonl`

mike: collecting heap/metrics from auth nodes. noticing elevated GC pauses on auth-03 around the window. posting small snippet:```
[auth-03] GC pause 420ms at 09:12:20Z memory=78% cpu=0.9
[auth-03] request queue depth spiked to 120 at 09:12:21Z
```

devon: that points to a node-specific resource pressure leading to timeouts — aligns with logs showing auth-03 returning 503.

elaine: customer comms: running impact estimate now, will prepare a short note: affected requests mostly /v1/generate with sync clients. No data loss reported.
sara: can we pin a timeline for the RCA? I'd like to assemble: initial spike 09:12Z, mitigation config 09:15Z, observed partial recovery 09:17Z, full recovery 09:25Z.
jordan: thanks team — assigning follow-up: eng-runtime to investigate GC cause on auth-03, infra to check node placement and noisy neighbors, SRE to draft RCA.

andre: I'll start collecting perf profiles and the full set of corrids for the RCA doc.
mike: adding note: create a playback in staging to reproduce retry amplification with induced auth latency.
sara: good. after we have raw traces + GC profile we can correlate. I'll open an incident tracker doc and paste these artifacts.

incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigated -> partial (retries reduced). Next steps: timeline assembly, artifact upload, RCA channel: #rca-3598887776 (private).

elaine: will handle customer notifications and include mitigations and ETA for RCA. tagging @support for followups. :thumbsup:

mike: final: leaving this thread for post-incident RCA. If anything else shows up ping me.

sara: thanks all, good mitigation.
